6931.rankIbnHajarEn: Thiqah (Trustworthy), Mutqin (Precise), Hafiz (Memorizer), an Imam and role model
6931.rankDhahabi: قال أحمد : ما رأيت مثله. وقال بندار : حدثنا إمام أهل زمانه يحيى القطان، واختلفت إليه عشرين سنة، فما أظن أنه عصى الله قط، ولد القطان 120، ومات 198 في صفر، وكان رأسا في العلم والعمل
6931.rankDhahabiEn: Ahmad said: I have not seen the likes of him. Bundar said: The Imam of his time, Yahya al-Qattan, narrated to us; I frequented him for twenty years, and I do not think he ever disobeyed Allah. Al-Qattan was born in 120 and died in 198 in Safar; he was a leader in knowledge and action
